description: This file contains unit tests for ADO.NET storage provider functionalities in Orleans, focusing on grain key hashing, string conversions, and key extension handling.

classes.name: AdotNetProviderFunctionalityTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for ADO.NET storage provider functionalities, including hashing, grain key conversions, and extensions.

methods.name: AdoNetStorageProviderGrainTypeHashing
methods.description: Tests thread-safe hashing behavior of the ADO.NET storage provider's hasher.

methods.name: LongGrainIdToN1KeyAreSame
methods.description: Verifies that a long grain ID correctly maps to its N1Key representation.

methods.name: LongGrainIdToStringAreSame
methods.description: Checks that a long grain ID converts to string consistently with its ToString method.

methods.name: LongGrainIdWithExtensionAreSame
methods.description: Tests that grain ID with an extension produces expected string format and splitting.

methods.name: GuidGrainIdWithExtensionAreSame
methods.description: Verifies that a GUID grain ID with an extension converts correctly to string.
